title: Engineering Design Challenge
description: A design engineer at a product company is evaluating a new mechanical subsystem against performance requirements and operating constraints. The engineer must compare evidence, identify risks, and justify the design decision before approval.

title: Engineering Risk Analysis
description: A systems engineer at an infrastructure company is reviewing a proposed control system after several operational incidents. The engineer must analyse technical risks, evaluate evidence, and determine which controls and responsibilities are required before deployment.

title: Science Investigation
description: A research scientist at an environmental laboratory is investigating an unexpected result in a controlled experiment. The scientist must compare evidence, assess uncertainty, and decide whether the available data supports the proposed conclusion.

title: Commerce Strategy
description: A strategy analyst at a mid-sized retail company is comparing two market-entry proposals. The analyst must evaluate commercial evidence, operational risks, and governance responsibilities before recommending an option.

title: Engineering Reliability Review
description: A reliability engineer at a manufacturing plant is reviewing repeated equipment failures before approving a maintenance redesign. The engineer must compare evidence, operational risks, and responsible control measures.

title: Engineering Safety Verification
description: A systems engineer at an infrastructure firm is reviewing a proposed control system before deployment. The engineer must verify performance evidence and determine whether unresolved safety risks require additional controls.

title: Engineering Requirements Review
description: A design engineer at a product company is evaluating competing prototypes against technical requirements and operating constraints. The engineer must document the evidence and justify the selected design.

title: Science Experimental Review
description: A research scientist at an environmental laboratory is reviewing an experiment with inconsistent measurements. The scientist must assess data quality, uncertainty, and whether the evidence supports the proposed conclusion.

title: Science Evidence Assessment
description: A laboratory research lead is evaluating competing explanations for an unexpected experimental result. The lead must compare evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and the implications of each interpretation.

title: Science Data Governance
description: A scientific data manager at a research institution is reviewing an analytical workflow before its results are used in a high-impact study. The manager must ensure traceability, appropriate review, and clear accountability for automated analysis.

title: Science Method Validation
description: A laboratory method specialist is deciding whether a new analytical procedure is sufficiently validated for routine use. The specialist must compare performance evidence, limitations, and verification requirements.

title: Commerce Market Entry
description: A strategy analyst at a mid-sized retail company is comparing two market-entry proposals. The analyst must evaluate assumptions, commercial risks, evidence, and governance requirements before recommending an option.

title: Commerce Supplier Decision
description: A procurement manager at a regional business is evaluating competing suppliers for a critical service. The manager must compare cost, quality, reliability, operational risk, and accountability before approval.

title: Commerce Forecast Review
description: A business planning analyst is reviewing a sales forecast that differs substantially from recent performance. The analyst must investigate assumptions, evidence quality, uncertainty, and decision consequences.

title: Commerce Customer Decision Governance
description: A customer operations manager is reviewing an automated recommendation process that influences customer-facing decisions. The manager must establish verification, accountability, documentation, and escalation controls.

title: Arts Exhibition Curation
description: A museum curator is developing an exhibition narrative from multiple historical sources with differing interpretations. The curator must evaluate evidence, context, representation, and the assumptions behind the proposed narrative.

title: Arts Provenance Review
description: A collections specialist at a museum is reviewing the provenance of an artwork before public display. The specialist must assess evidence quality, unresolved uncertainty, and the responsibilities associated with public claims.

title: Arts Cultural Interpretation
description: A cultural researcher is comparing interpretations of a historical work for an educational programme. The researcher must distinguish evidence from assumption and decide how uncertainty should be communicated.

title: Arts Public Narrative Review
description: A museum education lead is reviewing an automated draft of a public exhibition description. The lead must verify factual claims, identify limitations, and retain human editorial responsibility before publication.

title: Arts Contested Material Decision
description: A senior curator is deciding whether to include contested cultural material in a public exhibition. The curator must evaluate provenance, evidence, interpretive risk, and responsible communication before approval.
